news.text: My first visit to the host community service points in Cox's bazar. We thoroughly visited almost all the facilities and assessed data records, registration process and gained knowledge about the activities they are performing in community level. Meanwhile the visit, we captured some moments with the serene scenic beauty of Cox’s Bazar. Overall, it was an amazing day spent with my MIS brothers.
